# Predicted measurement quality (generated by run_simulations.py)

Phase A, from simulations 07 (ESC waveforms) and 08 (Monte Carlo on the tolerances), completed with the datasheets
for what is not simulated: the AD7606C-18 and the drift with temperature.

## How far a reading is from the truth

Error of one reading of a steady value, for three levels of calibration:

- **None**: the firmware uses the schematic values.
- **Zero**: the reading at 0 A is taken before the run and subtracted.
- **Zero and gain**: the gain has also been calibrated once against a known current and voltage. What is left is the drift 20 K away from that calibration, shunt self-heating included (datasheet maxima added together).

| True value | No calibration | Zero | Zero and gain |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 5 A | reads 5.40 … 6.12 A | ±0.03 A (±0.5 %) | ±0.008 A (±0.16 %) |
| 10 A | reads 10.40 … 11.13 A | ±0.05 A (±0.5 %) | ±0.017 A (±0.17 %) |
| 20 A | reads 20.39 … 21.13 A | ±0.10 A (±0.5 %) | ±0.041 A (±0.21 %) |
| 35 A | reads 35.34 … 36.16 A | ±0.18 A (±0.5 %) | ±0.105 A (±0.30 %) |
| 12 V | reads 11.76 … 12.07 V | as without calibration | ±0.040 V (±0.33 %) |
| 25.2 V | reads 24.70 … 25.34 V | as without calibration | ±0.083 V (±0.33 %) |
| 50 V | reads 49.01 … 50.27 V | as without calibration | ±0.165 V (±0.33 %) |

The first two columns hold for 95 % of the boards. On top of these figures: 10 mA rms and 0.85 mV rms of noise on one sample (it averages out), and ±58 mA on the current if the zero is not taken again after a 20 K change.

## What the test shows

- **Calibrate the zero of the current.** With the schematic constants the reading at 0 A is +0.75 A. Multiplied by the mean phase voltage (12.6 V) it adds 9.5 W to a phase that carries 90 W.
- **The gain of the current is the shunt.** Its ±0.5 % tolerance is the whole spread before a gain calibration.
- **The power under PWM depends on the inductance of the shunt.** The datasheet only says "below 10 nH". After DC calibration the power reads -4.2 % without inductance and +4.7 % with 10 nH: the phase between the two channels has to be measured on a real board.
- **Sample fast.** Below 200 kSPS the PWM aliases into the power (up to 17 % at the worst sampling phase over 4 ms).

## Shunt R1 / R4 / R7: PBV-R001-F1-0.5 (datasheet)

| Datasheet figure | Value | Effect on the current reading |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Tolerance | ±0.5 % | ±0.5 % of gain, removed by a gain calibration |
| Temperature coefficient | < 75 ppm/K | ±0.15 % for 20 K |
| Thermal resistance to ambient | < 15 K/W | at 35 A: 1.23 W of the 3 W allowed, +18 K, up to 0.14 % |
| Inductance | < 10 nH | changes the PWM ripple and the delay of the reading, see below |
| Thermal EMF | < 2 µV/K | 2 mA of offset per kelvin of difference between the two sense terminals |
| Stability | < 0.5 % after 2000 h | slow drift of the gain at nominal load |

The other resistors have no part number in the schematic: 1 % and 100 ppm/K are assumed for them.

## Test waveform (simulation 07)

- Battery 25.2 V, PWM 24 kHz, electrical frequency 1 kHz.
- Motor phase: 30 µH, 50 mΩ, back-EMF 8 V peak.
- Phase current 19.9 A peak at 1 kHz, 14.22 A rms with the PWM ripple (1.85 A rms of ripple).
- True power in the phase: 89.87 W.

## Dynamic accuracy (simulation 07, shunt without inductance)

| Quantity | Truth | Reading, schematic constants | Reading, after DC calibration |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Mean current | 0.000 A | 0.754 A | 0.001 A |
| RMS current | 14.220 A | 14.105 A (-0.81 %) | 14.085 A (-0.95 %) |
| Mean phase voltage | 12.600 V | 12.505 V (-0.75 %) | 12.600 V (-0.00 %) |
| RMS phase voltage | 17.798 V | 15.219 V (-14.49 %) | 15.333 V (-13.85 %) |

The RMS of the phase voltage is low because the filters round the PWM edges: use the mean or the fundamental, not the RMS.

| Phase power | Value | Error |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Truth | 89.87 W | |
| Reading, schematic constants | 94.88 W | +5.57 % |
| Reading, after DC calibration | 86.10 W | -4.19 % |
| Reading, DC calibration + time shift of the current | 91.02 W | +1.28 % |
| Reading, DC calibration + matched channel filters | 89.20 W | -0.75 % |

"Matched channel filters" means that the current reading is also filtered at the corner of the voltage channel and the
voltage reading at the corner of the current channel, in the firmware or with the same RC on both channels.

## Effect of the shunt inductance (simulation 07)

The inductance adds a voltage proportional to the slope of the current. It acts against the RC filter of the current channel.

| Shunt inductance | Delay of the current reading | Delay of the voltage reading | PWM ripple left | RMS current | Power after DC calibration | Power with a time shift of the current |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0 nH | 15.5 µs | 9.6 µs | 41 % | -0.95 % | -4.19 % | +1.28 % |
| 5 nH | 10.6 µs | 9.6 µs | 51 % | -0.82 % | +0.27 % | +1.29 % |
| 10 nH | 5.6 µs | 9.6 µs | 75 % | -0.42 % | +4.73 % | -1.44 % |

Delays are measured at the electrical frequency and include the AD7606C input filter.

| 100 kSPS | 4.31 % / 5.53 % | 4.52 % / 6.96 % | 0.77 % / 0.98 % |
| 200 kSPS | 4.21 % / 4.34 % | 4.72 % / 4.96 % | 0.75 % / 0.76 % |

## Static accuracy before calibration (simulation 08, 1000 boards)

Readings computed with the schematic constants. Each cell gives the mean and the interval that holds 95 % of the boards.

| Quantity | Analog chain (simulated) | With the ADC and its reference (datasheet) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Current reading at 0 A | +0.79 A (+0.56 … +1.01) | +0.76 A (+0.40 … +1.12) |
| Current gain error | -0.01 % (-0.48 … +0.47) | +0.01 % (-0.50 … +0.53) |
| Voltage reading at 0 V | -0.7 mV (-20.3 … +19.8) | -0.4 mV (-38.3 … +37.0) |
| Voltage gain error | -0.75 % (-2.00 … +0.50) | -0.73 % (-1.98 … +0.54) |

+2.5VA over the 1000 boards: 2.4995 V on average, 2.4949 … 2.5046 V. The AD7606C accepts 2.495 … 2.505 V on REFIN: 0.1 % of the boards are outside.

## Drift after calibration (datasheet maxima, 20 K)

| Contribution | Current | Voltage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Gain | ±0.16 % (shunt 75, INA241A2 1, ADC 3, reference 2 ppm/K) | ±0.33 % (divider with two 100 ppm/K resistors, assumed) |
| Zero | ±58 mA (mostly the ADC zero drift) | ±5 mV |
| Shunt self-heating | up to 0.14 % at 35 A | |

## Not covered by these simulations

- INA241A2 common-mode rejection and its 1 µs output hold at each PWM edge (behavioural model).
- Layout: Kelvin routing of the shunt, coupling of the PWM edges into the sense traces.
- The other two phases and the real motor: the waveform is a single-phase equivalent.
